name: sop
description: Standard operating procedure skills for repeatable engineering and analysis workflows, including review request submission, interactive branch review, and falsifiable scientific analysis.

interface.longDescription: SOP collects standard operating procedure skills for repeatable engineering and analysis tasks. It includes workflows for opening review requests from the current branch, walking through branch diffs interactively before a merge, and analyzing surprising empirical phenomena with falsifiable hypotheses, explicit evidence status, and experiment designs.
defaultPrompt: Use submit-mr to open a merge request or pull request
Create an MR or PR for the current branch
Use review-pr to walk through merging a source branch into a target branch
Use scientific-analyst to analyze an unexpected benchmark result
